personal.name: Saurabh Lokhande
personal.title: AI Engineer — Generative AI | Agentic Systems | LLM Architecture

summary: AI Engineer designing and building Generative AI systems since 2022, including agentic architectures, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and LLM-powered applications. Experienced in building AI SaaS platforms, multi-agent workflows, and scalable AI backends using Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, and vector databases. Strong focus on production architecture, orchestration, and real-world AI deployment beyond basic chatbot implementations.

points: Designed and deployed production-style AI systems focusing on agent orchestration, retrieval architecture, and scalable AI services.
Developed OpenReception — an AI receptionist SaaS platform capable of handling business calls, booking appointments, and answering queries autonomously.
Built AGEN — an AI agent browser platform with a WebUI, persistent browser sessions, and tool-calling architecture.
Designed a stateful Multi-Agent Research Automation System using LangGraph for automated workflows.
Developed an AI Resume Processing & Candidate Intelligence System to automatically extract structured candidate insights from cloud storage.
Worked on vision transformer and recommendation-engine models for real-world data streams.
Stack: TensorFlow, PyTorch, AWS, PostgreSQL, Scikit-Learn.
Built semantic retrieval engines and early vector search systems from raw data ingestion pipelines.
Stack: Pandas, Pinecone, Hugging Face, Docker, Python.

projects.name: Doc AI — Large-corpus RAG engine
projects.desc: Hybrid BM25 + dense retrieval fused with RRF, cross-encoder reranking and cited answers over 12 PDFs / 4,584 pages (with OCR), on open-source models running CPU-only. Measured on a 40-question synthetic set: Recall@3 97.5%, MRR@10 0.867, retrieval p50 0.55 s; full-answer p50 cut from ~31 s to 6.7 s (smaller model plus shorter prompts).

projects.name: Hire Me OS 2.0 — Job-search SaaS
projects.desc: Multi-tenant Next.js 16 + Supabase/Prisma app: an evaluation engine that writes 6 report blocks and scores 10 weighted dimensions into an A–F grade, an Autopilot scheduler and a Chrome extension.

projects.name: Multi-Agent Research Automation System
projects.desc: LangGraph pipeline (planner → researcher → verifier → writer) that replaces a single prompt chain with explicit, observable steps; runs locally on Ollama with DuckDuckGo search.

projects.desc: Designed LLM-driven conversational architecture with FastAPI backend, real-time AI processing, RAG pipeline for business knowledge retrieval, and integrated Twilio/voice APIs.
